findings.text: High, acceptance 6: the handle-wide cap no longer limits password guessing. In-process /api/login reproduction with distinct source IPs: guesses 1-20=401, 21-24=429, but all 24 execute scrypt; correct guess 25=200 with a session cookie. Verification precedes the cap, and correct guesses bypass it entirely. Enforce an account-wide delay/challenge before verification; bind any exemption to a previously trusted client.

F3 NOT ADDRESSED for shared-IP users: repeating 12 bad logins gives 8x401,4x429, then the correct password=429; a fresh IP succeeds. Consider a proven-client exemption. F1/F2/F4 ADDRESSED on repeated reproductions: four aliases share the eight-failure cap; raw handle is absent from failure/limit logs; bad-CSRF logout clears the cookie without changing epoch, and valid logout invalidates both device cookies.

F5 NOT ADDRESSED fully (acceptance 8): HTTP invite/disable/enable and enroll/WebAuthn limit logs pass, but direct createInvite/setDisabled calls emit zero security lines; CLI invite creation uses that path (src/cli/main.ts:413). Log at shared entry points or cover CLI separately. Verification: 19/19 targeted tests and typecheck passed; secrets scan could not run because temporary-directory creation was denied (EPERM).
